images.title: Four numbers in a box
images.purpose: Show the four numbers 9, 16, 25 and 43 as equal cards so the student can look for what makes each one special.
images.composition: Four equal square cards in one evenly spaced row, centred on a white page with one short line centred below.
images.exact_structure: One row of exactly 4 equal square cards with equal gaps, holding 9, 16, 25, 43. Cards 9, 16, 25 have a teal #0072B2 outline. Card 43 has an amber #E69F00 outline. Below, one grey #6B7280 line of text. Exactly 4 cards, 1 line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
cards of unequal size, or any extra number
images.takeaway: Every number can be special in its own way.
images.description: Four equal cards showing 9, 16, 25 and 43 in a row, with the line each one is special below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to pick one card and say one reason it looks special.

image_decisions.why: The open question starts from the four numbers themselves; one calm card row carries it.
